# Aldith

*Herb Wife of the Riverside*

|  |  |

## Personality

Earthy, warm and stubborn about old remedies. She swears by river mint for everything.

## Story

Aldith treats the riverside folk with herbs from her own garden, while her brother serves as the palace physician. They argue cheerfully about whose cures work best and secretly swap recipes.
